Best Claude Code Cost Saver

You're looking for a way to reduce your Claude Code costs, and tokentrim is a free, open-source toolkit that can help you do just that. tokentrim can save you money by trimming tool output, summarizing earlier conversations, and setting a daily budget guard.

How tokentrim Works for Claude Code Cost Savings

tokentrim trims tool output, reads files in ranges, and spools long output to disk, which can save you 6.9% on costs. The full install also sets a compaction window, which can save you even more by summarizing earlier conversations. On 135 real conversations, tokentrim cut history re-read by 75% and made limits last 4.0x longer.

What You Get with tokentrim

With tokentrim, you get a range of features, including all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold-cache alert, all for free. If you upgrade to Pro, you'll get additional features like a hosted dashboard on any device, Monday digest, weekly budget with alert at 80%, and Slack totals, all for $49 once for the first 500 buyers or $9/month.

FAQ

Do I need to pay for tokentrim? No, tokentrim is free and open-source, but you can upgrade to Pro for additional features. Is my data secure with tokentrim?
